title: Track 10 — rezzy-json Crate Extraction, Dependency-Free Parser & Canonical Numeric Limits (0.6.0-rc.1)
public_safety_audit_summary: Critical (Hash Split): Dual permissive (write_raw_canonical_filtered) and strict (write_raw_canonical_filtered_strict) canonical JSON writers, coupled with silent lossy as_f64 rounding for integers >= 2^53+1 (returning Some(rounded) instead of None), expose federation callers to reference-hash and content-signature split-brain risks if a caller confuses parser/permissive acceptance with Matrix signing canonicality.
